name: Parasite Eve HD Backgrounds
scope: Reviewed Day 1 backgrounds and animations, plus 186 static map candidates / 234 views across both discs. Includes the recorded material, lettering and E15 occlusion corrections.
runtime: Requires the HD WIP port build; PE_HD_BACKGROUNDS points to the pack directory.
validation: Native reference and unselected atlas texels unchanged; original state, native VRAM and PCM parity passed in hidden GPU integration test. Full runtime traversal of all new static maps not claimed.
assets: Private snapshot; artwork and disc-derived packs are not committed to Git.
